t: Email Notifications in Forms and Surveys
html:
Email Notifications in Eleva allow you to notify team members when someone submits a Form or Survey. You can also enable Auto Responder to send an automatic email to the person who submitted it. Both options can be configured directly in the Form or Survey Builder. 

This article covers notification setup, email settings, PDF attachments, and testing.

What Are Email Notifications and Auto Responder?

Email Notifications alert designated recipients when a Form or Survey is submitted, while Auto Responder sends an automatic email to the submitter. Both options can be enabled independently or together.

Auto Responder sends an automatic email to the person who submitted the Form or Survey.

You can use these features to:

  • notify team members about new submissions,
  • acknowledge the submitter automatically,
  • customize the email subject, sender name, and reply-to address,
  • and attach submission details as a PDF when supported.

Key Benefits of Email Notifications

These features help teams respond to submissions and keep submitters informed.

  • Instant Alerts: Notify team members about new submissions.

  • Automatic Responses: Send confirmation emails to submitters.

  • Multiple Recipients: Notify multiple email addresses.

  • Customizable Emails: Configure subjects, sender names, and reply-to addresses.

  • PDF Attachments: Include submission details as a PDF when supported.

Open Notification Settings

  1. Go to Sites > Forms or Sites > Surveys.
  2. Open an existing Form or Survey, or create a new one.
  3. In the builder, select the Notifications tab.

The Notifications panel lets you configure internal Email Notifications and Auto Responder emails.

Configure Email Notifications

  1. Open the Notifications tab.
  2. Enable Email Notification.
  3. Configure the available fields:
  • Subject — Enter the notification subject. If left blank, Eleva uses the Form or Survey name.
  • Email (To) — Enter one or more email addresses that should receive the notification.
  • Reply-to Email — Enter the email address that should receive replies to the notification.
  • Sender Name — Enter the name displayed as the sender. If left blank, Eleva uses the applicable sub-account or agency name.
    FieldDescription
    SubjectEnter the email subject. Defaults to the Form or Survey name if blank.
    Email (To)Enter one or more recipient email addresses.
    Reply-to EmailEnter the address that receives replies.
    Sender NameEnter the sender name. Defaults to the applicable sub-account or agency name if blank.
  1. Click Save.
Note: Email notifications use email credits. Confirm that your account has sufficient credits.

Attach Submission Details as a PDF

When the PDF attachment option is enabled, Eleva can include a PDF containing the submitted responses with the notification email.

The PDF is generated from the submission record when the email is sent.

To configure it:

  1. Open the Form or Survey.
  2. Select the Notifications tab.
  3. Enable Email Notification or Auto Responder, depending on where you want the attachment sent.
  4. Enable the available option to attach the submission as a PDF.
  5. Save your changes.

Note: Available PDF options can depend on the builder and submission type.



The PDF is generated from the submission record when the email is sent.


Steps

  1. Open the form or survey editor and click the Notification tab open notifications.
  2. Enable Email Notification  or Auto Responder.

  3. Auto Responder sends an automated email to the person who submits the form (email includes a copy of the information they entered in the form).

  4. Save your changes.

Configure Auto Responder

Auto Responder sends an automatic email to the person who submits the Form or Survey.

  1. Open the Notifications tab.
  2. Enable Auto Responder.
  3. Configure the available fields:
  • Subject — Enter the email subject. If left blank, Eleva uses the Form or Survey name.
  • Reply-to Email — Enter the email address that should receive replies from the submitter.
  • Sender Name — Enter the sender name. If left blank, Eleva uses the sub-account name.
  1. Save your changes.
Note: The Reply-to Email configured for Auto Responder applies to the email sent to the submitter. It does not change the Reply-to Email used for the internal Email Notification.

Test Your Notification Settings: After saving the form or survey, open its preview and submit a test response. Confirm that the internal notification and Auto Responder email reach the intended recipients.

How to View Survey Responses After Receiving an Email Notification

Email notifications serve as alerts only and do not include full survey responses. To view responses:

Steps:

  1. Navigate to Sites from the left-hand menu.

  2. Select the Surveys tab, then click Submissions.

  3. Review the list of submissions with timestamps and answers.

  4. Click an individual entry to see all responses.

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Can I send different notifications based on form or survey answers?

A: Not through native notification settings. Use a Workflow with a submission trigger and conditions to route notifications based on responses.

Q: Can I send notifications to multiple team members?

A: Yes. Enter multiple valid email addresses in the Email (To) field.

Q: Do Email Notifications and Auto Responder use email credits?

A: Yes. Both consume email credits. Emails may fail to send if sufficient credits are unavailable.

Q: What happens if one recipient email address is invalid?

A: Valid recipients can still receive notifications. An invalid address does not block delivery to other valid addresses.

Q: Can I use custom merge fields in the Email (To) field?

A: No. The field requires static email addresses. Use Workflows for notifications that require dynamic recipients.
